t1b.message: When enabled, every web page uses the 8 cat cursors: normal everywhere, click on links and buttons, pen on text fields, text on editable areas, help, precision on canvas, vertical resize on numbers and unavailable on disabled items. Clicks play a click sound and, rarely (8%), a meow.

t2b.message: Step 1: click the extensions button (puzzle piece) in the Firefox toolbar. Step 2: find CatCursorF in the list. Step 3: click the gear next to it and choose Pin to Toolbar. The icon stays fixed, one click away.

t3b.message: The main menu has the master power button and a display showing the state: DISABLED (all off), ENABLED (all on), ON / CURSOR OFF (sound only), ON / FX OFF (cursor only) or ON / ALL OFF. Cursor and sound can also be toggled separately in SETTINGS.

t4b.message: SETTINGS holds: Cursor ON/OFF, Sound ON/OFF, Holiday AUTO/ALWAYS/OFF (snow at Christmas, gold at New Year), ES/EN Language and 6 Themes: Calculator, Classic, Minecraft, GeoDash, Christmas and New Year. The toolbar icon follows the theme. Language can also be switched from the menu LANGUAGE button.

t5b.message: NETWORKS holds only personal links: YouTube, GitHub, GitLab, Email, AMO (Firefox profile) and My Web. The Email button copies the address to the clipboard and confirms. My Web shows 404 because it is not ready yet: stay tuned to the networks for updates.

t6b.message: GAME shows your money (you start with $$25). Type your bet or use -/+, ALL IN for everything, 0 allowed. Press PLAY, watch the cat, follow the shuffle and pick: win pays double. WORK gives +$$0.25 per click. Loans of 10/50/100 with REPAY; hitting 0 is GAME OVER and restarts. The goal: the $$1,000,000 cat statue.

t7b.message: Firefox blocks extensions on its internal pages (home, settings). To get the cat there too, follow chrome/LEEME.txt in the project folder (copy 2 CSS files and the .cur files to the profile and enable one preference), then restart Firefox. Replay this tutorial anytime from MORE - TUTORIAL.

victory.message: STATUE BOUGHT! You are a legend.

licBody.message:
CATCURSORF - Firefox Cursor Extension

Description: replaces browser cursors with custom cats. 8 contextual cursors, sounds, visual themes, interactive game and bilingual support.

Features

8 cat cursors · sounds (8% meow + click) · 6 visual themes · live settings panel · Shell game (free bets, work, loans, statue) · automatic holiday effects · ES/EN · works on websites, iframes and special pages · all local.

Requirements

Firefox 109+. Windows 7+ and Linux. About 3 MB.

Install

Development: about:debugging, This Firefox, Load Temporary Add-on, CatCursorF folder. Public: addons.mozilla.org, search CatCursorF, Add to Firefox.

Project structure

manifest.json · background.js · content.js · popup/ · tutorial/ · creditos/ · licencia/ · _locales/es+en/ · assets/{cursors, fx, icons, texturas} · chrome/ · versiones/ · build.py

Usage guide

Cat icon: master power and states on the display. SETTINGS: cursor, sound, holiday, stars, auto theme, language and 6 themes. LANGUAGE: instant ES/EN. NETWORKS: YouTube, GitHub, GitLab, email, AMO, My Web and itch.io. MORE: tutorial, credits and README. LICENSE: this text. GAME: bet anything (0 allowed, ALL IN for everything), win double, work +0.25, 10/50/100 loans, 0 is game over; goal: $$1,000,000 statue.

Cursor system

Normal, Link, Pen, Text, Help, Unavailable, Precision and Vertical, depending on element context.

Audio effects

Click on every click (Pixabay). 8% meow per click (own). Snow Nov 25-Jan 25 and gold Dec 31/Jan 1, disableable; hidden on video and fullscreen.

Permissions

Minimal: websites <all_urls> (cursors), local storage (settings), tabs (tutorial) and clipboard (copy email). No history, passwords or personal data.

Troubleshooting

No cursor: F5 and check ON. No sound: volume and SETTINGS. Home/settings: install chrome/LEEME.txt, enable the preference and restart. Temporary unloads on close: reload in about:debugging. Game data is local, lost when clearing cache.

Visual themes

Calculator (retro), Classic (neutral), Minecraft (blocks), GeoDash (neon), Christmas (red/green/gold) and New Year (gold).

Technical info

JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, WebExtensions API. .cur cursors, MP3 audio, local storage. ES/EN. Firefox 109+ on Windows and Linux.

Credits

Cursors: DUCK_BERET, from Hyper Bun Buster (ctmatthews.itch.io/polite-cat-mouse-cursor). Click: Pixabay. Meow: original Freezeezy Peak. Development: Freezeezy Peak.
